LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_Off: Needs Ideology, outside classic mode, with "Faith in the colony" on.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_PlayOut: Needs "Answers play out on the map" on: an evening of faith is a gathering.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_Pending: An evening of faith is already planned.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_Soon: The colony had an evening of faith only lately (one every five days at most).
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_FaithSoon: {FAITH} had its evening only lately (one every ten days at most for the same faith).
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_NoSpeaker: Nobody of {FAITH} at home is free and able to speak for it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_Alone: There's nobody else at home to hear it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_NoFaith: No faith at home has someone to speak for it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Why_FewBelievers: {FAITH} has nobody else at home to gather with.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Listeners: Of other faiths, {0} mean to come.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_NoListeners: Nobody of another faith means to come: it will be an evening for the faith's own.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_StayAway: {0} will stay away: their faith frowns on being preached to.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_NobodyCame: {SPEAKER_nameDef} offered to speak for {FAITH} this evening, but nobody else means to come. The faith won't ask again for a while.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Cause: It started at an evening of faith.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Moved: {0} came away less sure of their own faith.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Steadied: Those of {FAITH} went to bed surer of it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Outcome_Poor: {SPEAKER_nameDef} spoke for {FAITH}, and it never quite caught. People drifted off to bed.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Outcome_Fine: {SPEAKER_nameDef} spoke for {FAITH}, and nobody wanted the evening to end.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Chronicle_Poor: An evening of {FAITH} came to little, though {COUNT} came to hear {SPEAKER_nameDef}.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Chronicle_Good: An evening of {FAITH}: {COUNT} came to hear {SPEAKER_nameDef}, and listened.
LanguageData.CC_FaithEve_Chronicle_Fine: An evening of {FAITH}: {COUNT} came to hear {SPEAKER_nameDef}, and it was talked about for days.
LanguageData.CC_Cal_Way_Faith_Desc: with Ideology: the faith the day names gathers its believers and whoever else chooses to come, and its moral guide or most devout believer speaks for it; listeners of other faiths may be swayed, believers steadied. Without a speaker, a word at supper.
LanguageData.CC_Cal_Way_Faith_Letter: If the council keeps it, the faith's speaker will speak for it this evening, at its altar if it has one, to its believers and whoever else chooses to come.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_LearnFaith: {PAWN_nameDef} isn't as sure of {PAWN_possessive} own faith as {PAWN_pronoun} was, and {OTHER_nameDef} holds to {FAITH} like a rock.
LanguageData.CC_Promise_LearnFaith: {FOR_nameDef} will spend this evening with {OTHER_nameDef}, hearing about {SUBJECT}.
LanguageData.CC_Promise_LearnFaithTogether: {FOR_nameDef} will talk {SUBJECT} over with {OTHER_nameDef} the next time they're together.
LanguageData.CC_LearnFaith_Cause: It started with an evening spent learning about it.
LanguageData.CC_LearnFaith_Moved: {PAWN_nameDef} came back from the evening with {OTHER_nameDef} thinking hard about {FAITH}.
LanguageData.CC_FaithClash_WhyQuarrel: Only a few days ago {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} came to hard words, and faith was somewhere at the bottom of it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithClash_WhyAltar: And the {ALTAR} stands where everyone can see whose it is.
LanguageData.CC_FaithClash_Cause: The council named {FAITH} the colony's faith.
LanguageData.CC_Log_FaithNamed: took it hard when {FAITH} was named the colony's faith
LanguageData.CC_FaithClash_CornersText: The council has given each faith a corner of its own. Where each might keep it (a suggestion, nothing more; the faiths will find their own places in the end):\n\n{0}
LanguageData.CC_FaithClash_CornerRec: a corner of the rec room
LanguageData.CC_FaithClash_CornerDining: the end of the dining table, after supper
LanguageData.CC_FaithClash_CornerOutside: a quiet spot out of doors
LanguageData.CC_FaithDecree_CardChoose: You choose the faith as you declare it ({FAITH} has the most believers).
LanguageData.CC_FaithDecree_Named: The council has named {FAITH} the colony's faith. Its believers may speak of it as often as they like; everyone else will be hearing a good deal of it.
LanguageData.CC_FaithDecree_Lifted: {FAITH} is no longer the colony's faith by the council's word. Every faith is back on the same footing.
LanguageData.CC_FaithDecree_Cause: The council had named {FAITH} the colony's faith.
LanguageData.CC_Log_FaithDecree: {FAITH} is the colony's faith by decree, and theirs isn't
